description: Flow Control Settings Panel -- a workflow builder component (FlowControlPanel.tsx) for configuring per-workflow Inngest-inspired flow control policies and per-phase timeout overrides. Integrated into WorkflowEditor in qontinui-web. Produces two JSON strings (flow_control_json, phase_timeouts_json) persisted to unified_workflows table. At runtime, LoopController loads configs and enforces them: FlowControlEnforcer checks concurrency/throttle/debounce/rate-limit before admitting a workflow, and phase_timeout_ms enforces per-phase deadlines via check_timeout(). Backend: flow_control.rs, orchestrator/state.rs, loop_controller.rs, loop_handlers.rs, unified_workflows.rs, workflow_ops.rs, migrations v147.

groups.description: The FlowControlPanel communicates changes to its parent (WorkflowEditor) via callbacks. When any flow control value changes, onFlowControlChange fires with the serialized JSON.
